The '''Kexeeria system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Kexeerian Blasters Technology]] company.<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kexeeria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
